doubts: A network page of several access routes and track sections: W2 and W3 are the western and eastern access routes (each has its own time and distance), W4 and W5 are sections of the Hunter Valley Track as the page's 'popular sections', and W6 is the route from Forbes Hut to the West Branch bushline with its own time. Each is recorded as a one-way A to B. W1's route beyond Forbes Hut is not clear: the page says 'there are several other routes' beyond the hut and describes the West Branch bushline route (W6) and the Wills valley, but does not name which one reaches the forks, so W1's via stops at Forbes Hut. W1 end T10 ('The Forks') is assumed to be the forks the text names. Ferguson Creek has no stated bridge or ford, so it has no how. The Hunter River has no bridge stated, so it is a ford. W2 start (Kidds Bush Campsite) and end (Scrubby Creek) and W3's Dingle Burn Carpark have no entries, so their refs are null. Ferguson Hut is listed as a hut because the main way begins there. DOC gives no overall time for the page.
